storylines.title: Iran War
storylines.overview: The Iran War is a sustained international conflict centered on Iran, the United States and Israel, with military, maritime, economic and diplomatic consequences across the Persian Gulf and neighboring states. U.S. combat operations began on February 28, 2026, and security in the Strait of Hormuz has remained one of the conflict's central pressure points.
storylines.current_status: A sailor was killed during an attack on the Marshall Islands-flagged tanker Velos Sapphire in the Persian Gulf on November 5. The tanker was reportedly empty of cargo and en route to Bahrain when it was struck. Iran has claimed responsibility for the attack, which is part of a broader escalation of assaults on shipping in the region, including two other vessels that were reported to be on fire.
